[a8ad9620afb4] lesson desk (2026-09-14) [secondary]: LEDGER-PARSE'S REGEX NEVER HANDLED get_thread's FULL BODY FORMAT. search_threads snippets arrive as flattened single-line text ('Ticker: X Amount: $Y Price: $Z Shares: N'), but get_thread's plaintextBody renders each field as its own markdown-table row ('| Ticker: | X |\n| Amount: | $Y |...'). FIX: _led_extract now …
